runtime.execution: Tokio application tasks; streamed provider HTTP; sequential native actions and parallel child tasks; one shared async shell mutex.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns conversations/config/tool execution and child chats; consumes providers, MCP and workspace search services.

summary: Tailcall ForgeCode is a native Rust agent with configurable personas, child task delegation, deterministic context compression, filesystem/shell/MCP operations and compiled lifecycle hooks.

inspection.scope: Traced native main -> ForgeApp -> Orchestrator -> transformed streamed provider -> action registry -> results/context/save/continuation; inspected child sessions, abort/drop, shell ownership, compactor, SQLite, config cache, hooks and substantive tests.
inspection.limits: Source read only, reference not executed. No reference execution. Other provider formats inspected at router boundary only; no claim of complete external MCP/search implementations. Quiescence/rebuild not established. Abrupt stream abort bypasses final post-run save; latest completed-step saves remain.

actions.name: read, write, fs_search, remove, patch, multi_patch, undo
actions.input: file_path/path, line range/pattern, contents or edits; write.overwrite
actions.output: file/image values, matching lines, mutation result/diff or error; undo latest tracked change
actions.lifecycle: awaited under native timeout; read-before-edit metrics for edit/overwrite
actions.authority: agent tool allowlist; optional restricted policy; ordinary host filesystem

actions.name: sem_search
actions.lifecycle: query work parallel within one awaited tool; indexed-workspace requirement
actions.authority: agent allowlist and workspace search service

actions.name: shell
actions.output: stdout/stderr/exit_code; oversized output prefix/suffix plus retained file path
actions.lifecycle: one shared executor serializes; streams terminal output; tool timeout/drop kills direct child; no returned ongoing-job handle
actions.authority: optional restricted native policy, otherwise operator OS authority

actions.name: fetch
actions.output: fetched content or error; large result archive path

actions.name: followup
actions.lifecycle: interactive awaited tool; orchestrator yields so next user chat continues

actions.name: plan, skill, todo_write, todo_read
actions.output: plan artifact; skill text; updated/current todo state
actions.lifecycle: awaited; todos owned by conversation metrics and content keys
actions.authority: agent tools; no governed executable self-change

actions.name: task; dynamically named agent tools
actions.output: each child final text with conversation ID or error, some child stream events forwarded
actions.lifecycle: parallel awaited independent/resumed child chats; no timeout; parent cannot separately address a live child in this interface

actions.name: MCP tools / mcp reload
actions.input: server-discovered tool arguments; reload configured servers
actions.output: server-specific values or error; refreshed catalog
actions.lifecycle: MCP calls timed; service owns connection lifecycle
actions.authority: agent tool validation; native restricted policy branch does not wrap MCP dispatch

actions.name: ForgeApp.chat; EventHandle / Hook
actions.input: agent ID plus ChatRequest conversation/event; compiled event handlers mutate Conversation
actions.output: bounded response stream; completion/interrupt; handler-injected context
actions.lifecycle: owned task aborted on stream drop; normal terminal save; End additions can resume model loop
actions.authority: host program; compiled hooks selected by app, not model-loaded turn code

actions.name: /compact; compact_conversation
actions.input: current conversation and active agent compact policy
actions.output: before/after messages/tokens plus persisted structured summary
actions.lifecycle: in-place lossy context replacement, automatic response-hook path too
actions.authority: operator/API; no traced model restoration operation

actions.name: /dump; conversation JSON import
actions.input: HTML/JSON dump option; CLI conversation file
actions.output: current parent/related child records; editable imported conversation
actions.authority: operator; requires previously retained snapshot for repair

actions.name: update_config / reload_agents
actions.input: typed ConfigOperation session model/provider or other config
actions.lifecycle: future chats capture new agent; no staged executable refit or continuity transaction
actions.authority: operator/API config writes; cache reload error ignored

actions.name: Ctrl-C
actions.lifecycle: drops chat consumer; abort task; last completed persisted step remains; final-save block may never run

filesystem.detail: Concrete native read/search/edit/undo with per-agent tools, optional restricted policies and prior-read path gate; freshness is not checked.

processes.detail: Real shell execution and streaming, but global executor mutex serializes commands and no model-addressable ongoing handle; cancellation kills direct child only by drop.

code_actions.detail: Arbitrary ordinary shell programs can compute; native action schema has no persistent general-purpose program kernel or code-action orchestration language.

persistent_kernel.detail: Not established in catalog, orchestration or shell execution; no kernel session traced.

standing_database.detail: Internal SQLite conversation/todo persistence is host-owned; shell/MCP can compose external database access but no standing DB model contract traced.

workflow_programming.detail: Declarative agent/tool/prompt policies, parallel delegation and compiled mutable lifecycle hooks; no exposed programmable workflow interpreter. CI workflows are not agent workflows.

multi_model.detail: Per-agent model/provider and concurrent child conversations; adapter normalizes model-specific reasoning; no common live multi-model room.

live_collaboration.detail: Parent-child task delegation supports continued conversation ID and returned text; no live peer send/receive/observe/identity channel traced.

concurrent_work.detail: Task calls and semantic queries run concurrently, then pair results in original order; ordinary tools sequential, shared shell serial, no child handle for detached work.

steering_interrupt.detail: Ctrl-C drop aborts owned chat task; tools expire by timeout. No queued in-flight prompt steering traced; abrupt abort can bypass final save.

turn_redefinition.detail: Compiled lifecycle hooks mutate context; End additions resume loop. Model request/finish/tool phases remain compiled, not hot programmable model/operator turn replacement.

compaction.detail: Deterministic structured transformer compaction, threshold response hook and manual compact; retention/eviction ranges and preserved usage/last reasoning. Originals spliced away.

context_repair.detail: Editable conversation JSON dump/import lets operator restore supplied snapshot; no automatic repair of lost originals nor model context retrieval/repair action traced.

original_audit.detail: Stored context overwrites same DB row and compaction destroys originals. Tracing skips request payload and does not capture all success/delta events.

audit_query.detail: Conversation SQLite lookup/list and related-conversation dump support history inspection, not a queryable complete original audit.

hot_change.detail: Typed configuration writes invalidate agent cache; new chat captures agent/settings. MCP reload exists; no settled-turn pending change transaction traced; reload error ignored.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Conversation import/resume is available, but quiescence/outpost handoff and unresolved-work continuity through executable replacement not established in inspected paths.

remote_services.detail: Provider HTTP streams, MCP actions, fetch and workspace query services consumed; host owns its conversation database and shell execution.

self_improvement.detail: File edits and prompt/agent files enable ordinary development; no governed measured harness-improvement loop traced.

complaints.detail: Tracing/retry/error responses exist; model-authored grievance with state snapshot and external tracking not established.

authority.detail: Agent tool validation plus optional restricted-mode native operation policies and read-before-edit; MCP/agent dispatch has distinct authority branch.

evaluation.detail: Read source tests assert drop cancellation, compaction accounting, config merge, history/reminder ordering; no reference tests executed.

time_order.detail: Request count, ordered pairing, Tokio timeout and wall-clock conversation timestamps; no causal audit sequence or replay clock established.

evidence.claim: Native Rust Tokio entry into UI/application services.
Per-chat agent/model/tool configuration is resolved; compiled hooks build orchestrator; task saves after normal dispatch.
Request context transformers normalize tool calls/images/reasoning and stream model completion through AgentService.
Turn loops request, response hooks, paired actions, stored context; yields on followup/stop/error/request limits; End hooks adding messages resume.
OpenAI-compatible adapter serializes transformed request and consumes HTTP eventsource.
Concrete native catalog and task agent_id/tasks/session_id schema.
Native read/write/search/semantic queries/remove/patch/undo/shell/fetch/followup/plan/skill/todo dispatch.
Patch/multipatch and overwrite require prior read; operation emits UI output, dumps large data, produces paired result.
Prior-read checks accessed-path metrics, not current bytes; full large shell/fetch outputs saved to non-cleaning temporary file.
Allowed-tool validation; restricted-only native policy checks; timed native/MCP actions; Task/custom agents parallel untimed child chats.
Task tool calls run concurrently, other tools sequentially with UI acknowledgement and hooks; final pairing reconstructs original order.
Child new/resumed conversation via ForgeApp; stream-forward selected events and return final task text plus conversation identity.
Shared async mutex serializes shell commands; inherited stdin, captured concurrent stdout/stderr, kill_on_drop child, awaited exit.
Chat stream owns spawned task; Drop closes receiver and aborts JoinHandle.
Ctrl-C select drops active UI future and returns to prompt/finishes headless run.
Pure structured compaction selects range, summarizes transformations, splices away originals, transfers usage and last reasoning.
Response hook checks thresholds and replaces conversation context in place.
Explicit compact API computes before/after messages/tokens and persists compacted conversation.
SQLite upsert replaces same conversation context/metrics/title rather than immutable event journal.
Request hook logs no payload; response logs usage/count; tool failures have output logging. Not complete request/delta/success event audit.
Operator conversation-file import accepts editable full ConversationDump or Conversation JSON and upserts context.
JSON dump exports current conversation and related child conversations, not original event history.
Session config update invalidates agent cache after write; reload error intentionally ignored.
Agents cached in memory; reload clears cache then reloads; no executable replacement.
Agent files configure model/provider/prompt templates/tools/compact/maxturns; these are declarative policies.
Compiled lifecycle EventHandle can mutate Conversation and handlers compose in order.
End hook injects pending-todo reminder once per same set; unchanged pending items need not prevent second Stop completion.
Source oracle asserts reminder content; two Stop replies finish even though todos remain pending.
Virtual-time Drop test asserts task completed flag remains false, not OS descendant or save durability.
Compaction oracle checks usage accumulation across destroyed original messages and surviving messages.
Compaction merge regression explicitly expects default agent retention_window zero to override workflow retention ten.
Repeated-call test asserts fourth successful action retained and next-request reminder follows triggering history.
MCP discovery accepts legacy and Claude name styles and routes tool call through service.
Provider routing and model-cache refresh task retained via abort handle, separate from chat request task.
Concrete shell/fetch/followup/plan/skill/todo arguments.
Tool name lookup normalizes catalog names; followup asks orchestrator to yield.

tests.oracle: Virtual-time completion flag stays false after stream drop; does not assert process descendants or final context durability.
Explicit summed usage and surviving message equality; safe threshold simulation tests policy estimates, not a live provider window.
Mock replies assert reminder after repeated successful tool history; pending-todo test confirms two Stop responses complete with unchanged pending items.
Regression expects default retention_window=0 to win over workflow ten; records current behavior, not independent desired requirement.

strengths: Native scheduler and explicit stream ownership make cancellation path inspectable.
Tool-call IDs and original order retained across concurrent child task batch.
Pure structured compaction avoids extra provider request and transfers accounting.
End-hook continuation is a concrete host program composition point.
limits: No reference execution. Other provider formats inspected at router boundary only; no claim of complete external MCP/search implementations. Quiescence/rebuild not established. Abrupt stream abort bypasses final post-run save; latest completed-step saves remain.
arconaut_questions: Should dropping a UI observer cancel work, or detach only its view? How does persistence survive interrupted phases?
How should per-agent child workflows consume shared process/database services without secretly serializing independent computations?
Can deterministic compression preserve references to originals and give the model selective repair operations?
Which configuration defaults mean unset versus deliberate zero, and which activation transaction enforces current-turn/workflow boundaries?
